description: Land Title Settlement Department - Divulgahamulawatta, Mallawapitiya D/S/Division Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.420202 (24/0271)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and owner details) in various villages, documenting the official registration of land titles and ownership details. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations, property ownership, and land titles.
